mapper.sql: select treservoir.id, treservoir.name, treservoir.code, treservoir.area_id, treservoir.status, treservoir.remark, treservoir.create_by, treservoir.create_time, treservoir.update_by, treservoir.update_time, treservoir.dept_id, treservoir.dept_name, treservoir.del_flag from t_reservoir treservoir
mapper.select:
select tr.id, tr.status, tr.area_id, tr.name, tr.code, tr.create_by, tr.create_time, tr.update_by, tr.update_time, tr.remark, tr.del_flag, ta.name as areaName,tc.name as categoryName,tr.code from t_reservoir tr left join t_area ta on ta.id = tr.area_id left join t_category tc on tr.id = tc.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tr.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
tr.del_flag = '0' and tr.area_id = #{areaId} and tr.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and tr.status = #{status}
${params.dataScope} order by tr.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_reservoir set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_reservoir set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.update: update t_reservoir set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT tr.id,tr.`name`,tr.`status`,IFNULL(ta.`name`,'') as areaName FROM t_reservoir tr left join t_area ta on ta.id=tr.area_id WHERE tr.del_flag='0' and tr.area_id=#{areaId}

SELECT r.name reservoirName, IFNULL(a.name,'') as areaName, count(l.id) totalCount, count(case when l.status='1' and l.goods_allocation_status!=1 then 1 else null end) useCount FROM t_reservoir r left join t_area a on a.id=r.area_id left join t_location l on r.id=l.reservoir_id AND l.del_flag='0' AND l.location_type='0' WHERE r.del_flag='0' and r.area_id=#{areaId} group by r.id
